name: bingwlp
description: Web app che replica Bing Wallpaper: temi, carosello immagini, fullscreen, download multi-risoluzione.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace web && npm run build --workspace server
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace server && npm run test --workspace web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace server && npm run typecheck --workspace web
scripts.ci: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run test
